about.heading: Five years of systems that had to keep running
about.body_1: I'm a Senior Software Engineer working across the full stack, with a deliberate bias toward the parts that are hard to change later: data models, integration boundaries, and the failure modes nobody plans for.
about.body_2: Most of my time goes into a multi-tenant logistics platform that moves thousands of shipments a day across three countries. Fifteen branches depend on it, which is a useful constraint — it means every decision gets judged on whether it still works at 2am when a carrier API starts returning nonsense.
about.body_3: Alongside that I build and run AI Caller, an AI phone receptionist that answers real customer calls and only says things it can back up with the caller's own documents. That product taught me more about AI engineering than any tutorial could: the model is the easy part, and grounding is a product decision, not a technical one.
about.body_4: Before that I spent two years freelancing for international clients, reaching Top Rated status with 250+ five-star reviews. I still take on select freelance projects where the problem is interesting.
